doc.name: A — non alc spirits catalogue, weathered wood, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: zero-proof aperitif bottle
Category: non alc spirits
Shot programme: weathered wood
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are the visual lead responsible for this non alc spirits product library. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the in-context lifestyle in a weathered wood treatment.

SUBJECT. A zero-proof aperitif bottle. Copy the product from the reference verbatim in form and finish. If a detail is unreadable in the reference, keep it neutral rather than inventing one.

CAMERA. Product in its real use environment with lived-in supporting props. Shoot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/1.2, framing for deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with flickering firelight as the only motivated source. Stage the product on or against draped silk, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
